content:
| Quest stages | 
|---|
| Stage | Status | Description | Log Entry | 
| ? | | Listen to Abbie | I discovered an old bunker in the Mire. When I entered, a voice recording came over an intercom system. I should listen to it and find out what the creator was up to. | 
| ? | | Find the missing Uplink | I triggered a recorded message from a woman named Abbie. She asked for my help to find a missing uplink. Abbie said the last person who had it was a man named Madigan, heading toward Top of the World. | 
| ? | | Repair the Broken Uplink | I have Madigan's uplink, but it's broken and needs repairs. Once I have the parts, I need to repair it at a tinker's workbench. Abbie mentioned she has one in her bunker. | 
| ? | | Select Uplink Repaired at the Scorched Detection System | Now that I have repaired the uplink, I should check in at the SDS terminal. I need to find the "Uplink Repaired" option to trigger Abbie's next message. | 
| ? | | Enter Raleigh's bunker | Abbie's last recording said I need to get inside Raleigh Clay's bunker to recover some fan motors. She gave me the password so I could get inside. Now all I need to do is find it. | 
| ? | | Find a Heating Coil at Ella's bunker | After entering Raleigh Clay's bunker, another message from Abbie came over the intercom system. She said I can find the fan motors in the generator room, but will also need to look for heating coils and potentially some schematics for some helpful protection in the Mire. | 
| ? | | Find a Heating Coil at the Relay Tower | | 
| ? | | Find Heating Coils at Abbie's bunker | | 
| ? | | (Optional) Find Raleigh's Schematics | | 
| ? | | Find the Fan Motors (0/5) | | 
| ? | | Craft Upgraded Motors (0/5) | Now that I have both the fan motors and the heating coils, I need to find a tinker's workbench to create the upgraded motors I need for the Scorched Detectors. Abbie has mentioned she has one in her bunker if I can't find one easily. | 
| ? | ![Quest finished](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/0/0f/Icon_check.png) | Select Motors Upgraded at the Scorched Detection Terminal | I've finally created the upgraded motors for the Scorched Detectors. I need to check in at the SDS terminal and select the "Upgraded Motors" option to see what's next. |
